The booking came via the Speakers’ Corner agency. The fee was paid by the Peabody Group (registered December 2025); I delivered a speech and took part in a subsequent Q&A at The Business of Events: UK Policy Forum on 7 July 2026. The Business of Events describes itself as a global think tank and advocacy network for the business events sector. I was invited to take part by the NMP Live speaker bureau. The fee was paid by The Business of Events (registered July 2026); I delivered a speech, and took part in a subsequent question and answer session, at the Association of Event Organisers (AEO) Business Breakfast on 3 September 2026. The AEO describes itself as the “premier trade association for companies that create, develop, and manage trade and consumer events”. I was invited to take part by the NMP Live speaker bureau. The fee was paid by the Association of Event Organisers (registered 8 September 2026).
